question: Find the average elevation of all Location nodes that use the coordinate system 'CS0008'.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location) WHERE loc.coordinate_system = 'CS0008' RETURN AVG(loc.elevation) AS average_elevation

question: Identify all InfrastructureNetwork nodes that span across more than two AdministrativeAreas and return their network type and status.
gql: MATCH (inf:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN inf, COUNT(aa) AS area_count NEXT RETURN inf.network_type, inf.status

question: List all PointOfInterest nodes located within AdministrativeAreas that have a population greater than 50000, and return their names and categories.
gql: MATCH (a:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(p:PointOfInterest) WHERE a.population > 50000 RETURN p.name, p.category

question: Find the average area in square kilometers of all AdministrativeAreas that overlap with GeographicZone GZ001.
gql: MATCH (gz:GeographicZone)-[:OverlapsWith]->(a:AdministrativeArea) WHERE gz.GeographicZone_id = "GZ001" RETURN AVG(a.area_km2) AS average_area

question: Determine the total capacity of all PointsOfInterest within GeographicZones that use the coordinate system CS0008.
gql: MATCH (cs:CoordinateSystem)<-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]-(gz:GeographicZone)-[:ContainsPoi]->(p:PointOfInterest) WHERE cs.CoordinateSystem_id = "CS0008" RETURN SUM(p.capacity) AS total_capacity

question: Find the total area (in km²) of all administrative areas that overlap with a specific geographic zone identified by 'GZ001'.
gql: MATCH (gz:GeographicZone {GeographicZone_id: 'GZ001'})-[:OverlapsWith]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN SUM(aa.area_km2) AS total_area

question: Identify all infrastructure networks that span across more than one administrative area, and count how many areas each network spans.
gql: MATCH (inf:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN inf, COUNT(aa) AS area_count NEXT RETURN inf.InfrastructureNetwork_id, area_count

question: For each coordinate system used by more than 5 locations, find the average elevation of those locations.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) RETURN cs, COUNT(loc) AS loc_count NEXT MATCH (loc2:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs) RETURN cs.name, AVG(loc2.elevation) AS avg_elevation

question: For each coordinate system used by more than five locations, list the system's name and the number of locations using it.
gql: MATCH (cs:CoordinateSystem)<-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]-(loc:Location) RETURN cs, COUNT(loc) AS usage_count NEXT RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, usage_count AS LocationUsageCount

question: Find the average elevation of all Location nodes that use the coordinate system with datum 'WGS84'.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) WHERE cs.datum = "WGS84" RETURN AVG(l.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: Find the total capacity of all infrastructure networks that span across administrative areas established before the year 2000.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.establishment_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN SUM(infra.capacity) AS TotalCapacity

question: Calculate the average elevation of locations that use a coordinate system with the unit of measurement 'meters'.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) WHERE cs.unit_of_measurement = 'meters' RETURN AVG(loc.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: List all administrative areas that border each other and have a population greater than 50000, showing their names and establishment dates
gql: MATCH (a1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(a2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE a1.population > 50000 AND a2.population > 50000 RETURN a1.name, a1.establishment_date, a2.name, a2.establishment_date

question: Find the average area in square kilometers of administrative areas that contain points of interest categorized as 'park'
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'park' RETURN AVG(aa.area_km2) AS average_area_km2

question: Count the number of demographic regions served by each administrative area, and display only those areas serving more than three regions along with their names
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) RETURN aa, COUNT(dr) AS region_count NEXT RETURN aa.name, region_count

question: List all PointOfInterest nodes located within AdministrativeAreas that have a population greater than 50000, along with the name of the administrative area and the point of interest.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 50000 RETURN aa.name AS administrative_area_name, poi.name AS point_of_interest_name

question: For each DemographicRegion, find the total number of PointOfInterest nodes contained within all associated AdministrativeAreas and GeographicZones, ordered by the total count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (dr:DemographicRegion)<-[:ServesDemographic]-(entity)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) RETURN dr.region_name AS demographic_region, COUNT(poi) AS total_points_of_interest ORDER BY total_points_of_interest DESC

question: Find the average elevation of all Location nodes that are part of a GeographicZone with zone_type 'Urban'
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(:AdministrativeArea)<-[:OverlapsWith]-(gz:GeographicZone) WHERE gz.zone_type = 'Urban' RETURN AVG(l.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: For each CoordinateSystem used by more than five Location nodes, find the name of the coordinate system and the number of locations using it.
gql: MATCH (cs:CoordinateSystem)<-[ucs:UsesCoordinateSystem]-(l:Location) RETURN cs, COUNT(l) AS location_count NEXT RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, location_count AS NumberOfLocations

question: Identify DemographicRegions served by AdministrativeAreas established before the year 2000, and return the region name and establishment date
gql: MATCH (dr:DemographicRegion)<-[:ServesDemographic]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.establishment_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN dr.region_name, aa.establishment_date LIMIT 10

question: Find the average population of administrative areas that contain points of interest categorized as 'Hospital'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' RETURN AVG(aa.population) AS average_population

question: Find all CoordinateSystem nodes used by Locations which are also part of an AdministrativeArea that borders another AdministrativeArea with a different governing body, returning the CoordinateSystem name and the count of such Locations
gql: MATCH (cs:CoordinateSystem)<-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]-(l:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa1.governing_body <> aa2.governing_body RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, COUNT(l) AS LocationCount

question: Find all AdministrativeAreas that border at least two other AdministrativeAreas and list their names along with the count of borders.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(neighbor:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa, COUNT(neighbor) AS border_count NEXT RETURN aa.name AS AdministrativeAreaName, border_count AS BorderCount

question: Find the total area (in km²) of all AdministrativeAreas that border at least one other AdministrativeArea with a different governing body. Only consider areas where the coordinate system used is 'WGS84'.
gql: MATCH (aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:LocatedIn]->(l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) WHERE cs.name = 'WGS84' RETURN aa1 NEXT MATCH (aa1)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa1.governing_body <> aa2 RETURN SUM(aa1.area_km2) AS TotalArea

question: Retrieve the names of all InfrastructureNetworks that connect AdministrativeAreas having PointsOfInterest categorized as 'Hospital' and ensure that these networks have a status of 'Operational'.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' AND infra.status = 'Operational' RETURN DISTINCT infra.InfrastructureNetwork_id

question: Find the maximum capacity among PointsOfInterest located in AdministrativeAreas governed by 'City Council' and also contained within a GeographicZone described as 'Metropolitan Area'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(gz:GeographicZone) WHERE aa.governing_body = 'City Council' AND gz.description = 'Metropolitan Area' RETURN MAX(poi.capacity) AS max_capacity

question: Find the average population of administrative areas that contain at least one point of interest categorized as a 'Hospital' and are served by more than two demographic regions.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(p:PointOfInterest) WHERE p.category = 'Hospital' RETURN aa NEXT MATCH (aa)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) RETURN aa, COUNT(dr) AS region_count NEXT RETURN AVG(aa.population) AS average_population

question: Retrieve the total capacity of all PointOfInterests categorized as 'Hospital' within each AdministrativeArea, and order the results by total capacity in descending order.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' RETURN aa.name AS AdministrativeAreaName, SUM(poi.capacity) AS TotalCapacity ORDER BY TotalCapacity DESC

question: For each CoordinateSystem used by at least three Locations, find the average latitude and longitude of those locations, and include the name of the CoordinateSystem.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) RETURN cs, COUNT(loc) AS location_count, AVG(loc.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(loc.longitude) AS avg_longitude NEXT RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, avg_latitude AS AverageLatitude, avg_longitude AS AverageLongitude

question: List all InfrastructureNetwork nodes that span across AdministrativeAreas which serve more than one DemographicRegion, along with the network type and the number of demographic regions served.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) RETURN infra, COUNT(dr) AS demographic_count NEXT RETURN infra.network_type AS NetworkType, demographic_count

question: Find the average elevation of Locations situated in AdministrativeAreas that were established after the year 2000 and belong to a GeographicZone of type 'Urban'.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:OverlapsWith]->(gz:GeographicZone) WHERE aa.establishment_date > date('2000-01-01') AND gz.zone_type = 'Urban' RETURN AVG(loc.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: Calculate the total capacity of infrastructure networks spanning administrative areas that serve demographic regions surveyed after January 1, 2020.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE dr.survey_date > date('2020-01-01') RETURN SUM(infra.capacity) AS total_capacity

question: Find the maximum elevation among locations situated in administrative areas which are governed by a body named 'Metropolitan Council' and also overlap with a demographic region.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:OverlapsWith]->(:DemographicRegion) WHERE aa.governing_body = 'Metropolitan Council' RETURN MAX(l.elevation) AS max_elevation

question: Identify the administrative areas that share borders with at least three other administrative areas and have a population greater than 500,000.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(neighbor:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 500000 RETURN aa, COUNT(neighbor) AS border_count NEXT RETURN aa.name AS administrative_area, border_count

question: List the names and categories of PointOfInterest nodes that are located in AdministrativeAreas with a population greater than 500,000 and are served by a DemographicRegion surveyed after 2020.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE aa.population > 500000 AND dr.survey_date > date('2020-12-31') RETURN poi.name, poi.category

question: Find the total capacity of InfrastructureNetworks that span across AdministrativeAreas which border at least two other AdministrativeAreas.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(other:AdministrativeArea) RETURN infra, COUNT(other) AS border_count NEXT RETURN infra.InfrastructureNetwork_id, SUM(infra.capacity) AS TotalCapacity

question: Calculate the average area in km² of AdministrativeAreas that contain PointsOfInterest categorized as 'Hospital' and are located in a GeographicZone of type 'Metropolitan'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest)-[:LocatedIn]->(:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' RETURN aa NEXT MATCH (aa)-[:OverlapsWith]->(gz:GeographicZone) WHERE gz.zone_type = 'Metropolitan' RETURN AVG(aa.area_km2) AS AverageArea

question: Identify the administrative areas that have at least one point of interest categorized as 'Hospital' and calculate the total population of these areas.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' RETURN aa.name, SUM(aa.population) AS total_population

question: Retrieve the total capacity of all InfrastructureNetwork nodes that span across AdministrativeAreas established after 1990 and connected to at least one DemographicRegion with economic indicators showing 'High GDP'.
gql: MATCH (inf:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE aa.establishment_date > date('1990-01-01') AND dr.economic_indicators = 'High GDP' RETURN SUM(inf.capacity) AS total_capacity

question: Find the maximum area in square kilometers among AdministrativeAreas that contain PointsOfInterest with a capacity exceeding 5000 and are serviced by a DemographicRegion surveyed after 2010.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE poi.capacity > 5000 AND dr.survey_date > date('2010-01-01') RETURN MAX(aa.area_km2) AS max_area

question: List the names of all PointOfInterest nodes that are contained within AdministrativeAreas having a population greater than 100,000, and also return the name of the AdministrativeArea they belong to.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 100000 RETURN poi.name AS PointOfInterestName, aa.name AS AdministrativeAreaName

question: Determine the number of PointOfInterest nodes in each category located within AdministrativeAreas that border at least two other AdministrativeAreas, and order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(other_aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa, COUNT(other_aa) AS border_count NEXT MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa) RETURN poi.category AS Category, COUNT(poi) AS POICount ORDER BY POICount DESC

question: Find the average elevation of Location nodes that use a specific coordinate system named 'WGS 84' and are located within AdministrativeAreas having a population less than 10000.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem {name: 'WGS 84'}), (l)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population < 10000 RETURN AVG(l.elevation) AS average_elevation

question: Find all PointOfInterest nodes that are located in AdministrativeAreas which border at least three other AdministrativeAreas, and return the names of these points of interest along with the names of their respective administrative areas.
gql: MATCH (aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa1, COUNT(aa2) AS border_count NEXT MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa1) RETURN poi.name AS PointOfInterestName, aa1.name AS AdministrativeAreaName

question: List each CoordinateSystem's name alongside the maximum and minimum elevation values of Locations using that system, considering only systems used by more than two locations.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) RETURN cs, COUNT(loc) AS loc_count NEXT MATCH (loc2:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs) RETURN cs.name AS coordinate_system_name, MAX(loc2.elevation) AS max_elevation, MIN(loc2.elevation) AS min_elevation

question: List the names of all PointOfInterest nodes located within AdministrativeAreas that have a population greater than 1 million and were established after January 1, 1950.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 1000000 AND aa.establishment_date > date('1950-01-01') RETURN poi.name LIMIT 10

question: List the names and establishment dates of AdministrativeAreas that border at least two other AdministrativeAreas governed by a different body and also contain at least one PointOfInterest categorized as 'Hospital'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.governing_body <> aa2 RETURN aa NEXT MATCH (aa)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'Hospital' RETURN aa.name AS AdministrativeAreaName, aa.establishment_date AS EstablishmentDate

question: Identify AdministrativeAreas that border at least three other AdministrativeAreas and have a population greater than 100000; return their names and establishment dates.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(neighbor:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 100000 RETURN aa, COUNT(neighbor) AS border_count NEXT RETURN aa.name, aa.establishment_date

question: Retrieve the names of DemographicRegions served by AdministrativeAreas which also contain at least one PointOfInterest categorized as 'School'; order the results by the survey date of the demographic region.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion), (aa)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'School' RETURN DISTINCT dr.region_name ORDER BY dr.survey_date

question: Calculate the average area in square kilometers (area_km2) of AdministrativeAreas that are served by at least one DemographicRegion and are connected to an InfrastructureNetwork of type 'Road Network'; return the average area.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(:DemographicRegion), (aa)<-[:Spans]-(:InfrastructureNetwork {network_type: 'Road Network'}) RETURN AVG(aa.area_km2) AS avg_area

question: Return the names of DemographicRegions served by AdministrativeAreas that have a population between 10000 and 100000, along with the region's survey date and economic indicators.
gql: MATCH (dr:DemographicRegion)<-[:ServesDemographic]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population >= 10000 AND aa.population <= 100000 RETURN dr.region_name, dr.survey_date, dr.economic_indicators

question: Determine the number of PointsOfInterest per category within each AdministrativeArea, and order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa.name AS administrative_area_name, poi.category, COUNT(poi) AS poi_count ORDER BY poi_count DESC

question: Find the maximum elevation among Locations that use the 'NAD83' coordinate system and are contained within PointsOfInterest categorized as 'Observatory'.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(:CoordinateSystem {name: 'NAD83'}), (l)-[:LocatedIn]->(:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.category = 'Observatory' RETURN MAX(l.elevation) AS max_elevation

question: Identify AdministrativeAreas that have a population greater than 1 million and are served by DemographicRegions surveyed before 2010. Return the area name and survey date.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE aa.population > 1000000 AND dr.survey_date < date('2010-01-01') RETURN aa.name AS AreaName, dr.survey_date AS SurveyDate

question: Find the average elevation of Location nodes that use a specific CoordinateSystem named 'WGS84' and are located within AdministrativeAreas established before 1950.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem), (loc)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE cs.name = 'WGS84' AND aa.establishment_date < date('1950-01-01') RETURN AVG(loc.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: Find the names of all AdministrativeAreas that contain at least one PointOfInterest with a capacity over 50 and are also bordered by at least two other AdministrativeAreas, returning the area names along with the count of their neighboring areas.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE poi.capacity > 50 RETURN aa NEXT MATCH (aa)-[:Borders]->(neighbor:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa, COUNT(neighbor) AS neighbor_count NEXT RETURN aa.name AS AdministrativeAreaName, neighbor_count

question: Identify DemographicRegions served by AdministrativeAreas that span InfrastructureNetworks with status 'Operational' and have been surveyed before 2015. Include in your result the region name and the survey date.
gql: MATCH (dr:DemographicRegion)<-[:ServesDemographic]-(aa:AdministrativeArea)<-[:Spans]-(infra:InfrastructureNetwork) WHERE infra.status = 'Operational' AND dr.survey_date < date('2015-01-01') RETURN dr.region_name AS RegionName, dr.survey_date AS SurveyDate

question: Find all PointOfInterest nodes that are located in AdministrativeAreas which border other AdministrativeAreas having an area greater than 500 km². Return the PointOfInterest name, its category, and the name of the AdministrativeArea it belongs to.
gql: MATCH (poi:PointOfInterest)<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa2.area_km2 > 500 RETURN poi.name AS PointOfInterestName, poi.category AS Category, aa1.name AS AdministrativeAreaName

question: List the CoordinateSystems used by Locations that are situated in AdministrativeAreas established before 1950 and have a precision level of 'high'. Include the datum and unit of measurement of each CoordinateSystem.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem), (l)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.establishment_date < date('1950-01-01') AND l.precision_level = 'high' RETURN DISTINCT cs.datum, cs.unit_of_measurement

question: Identify the total population of all AdministrativeAreas that overlap with a GeographicZone of type 'Urban' and are served by a DemographicRegion with a recorded cultural metric.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:OverlapsWith]->(gz:GeographicZone)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE gz.zone_type = 'Urban' AND dr.cultural_metrics IS NOT NULL RETURN SUM(aa.population) AS total_population

question: Find the average area in square kilometers of AdministrativeAreas that contain PointsOfInterest with a capacity exceeding 1000 and are part of an InfrastructureNetwork with a status of 'Under Maintenance'.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest) WHERE infra.status = 'Under Maintenance' AND poi.capacity > 1000 RETURN AVG(aa.area_km2) AS average_area_km2

question: Find the average population of AdministrativeAreas that are connected to at least two different DemographicRegions and also span an InfrastructureNetwork of type 'Railway Network'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE inf.network_type = 'Railway Network' RETURN aa, COUNT(dr) AS demographic_count NEXT RETURN AVG(aa.population) AS avg_population

question: List all InfrastructureNetwork nodes that span AdministrativeAreas with a population greater than 500,000 and return the network type along with the total area (sum of area_km2) of the AdministrativeAreas they span.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 500000 RETURN infra.network_type AS NetworkType, SUM(aa.area_km2) AS TotalArea

question: Determine the average elevation of Location nodes grouped by their coordinate system name, excluding locations without elevation data.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) WHERE loc.elevation IS NOT NULL RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, AVG(loc.elevation) AS AverageElevation

question: Calculate the average elevation of all Location nodes that utilize a CoordinateSystem with the datum 'WGS84' and are situated within AdministrativeAreas established before the year 1900.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem), (loc)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE cs.datum = 'WGS84' AND aa.establishment_date < date('1900-01-01') RETURN AVG(loc.elevation) AS average_elevation

question: List the names of DemographicRegions served by AdministrativeAreas that have a population less than 100,000 and are connected via Borders to another AdministrativeArea with a larger population. Include only those regions surveyed in the last five years.
gql: MATCH (dr:DemographicRegion)<-[:ServesDemographic]-(aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa1.population < 100000 AND aa2.population > aa1.population AND dr.survey_date > date('2019-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT dr.region_name AS DemographicRegionName

question: Identify the average elevation of locations within administrative areas that border at least two other administrative areas and have a population greater than 500,000.
gql: MATCH (aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) RETURN aa1, COUNT(aa2) AS border_count NEXT MATCH (l:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa1) RETURN AVG(l.elevation) AS avg_elevation

question: Find the total area in square kilometers of administrative areas that contain points of interest categorized as 'Historical Site' and are served by demographic regions with economic indicators showing 'High Income'.
gql: MATCH (aa:AdministrativeArea)-[:ContainsPoi]->(poi:PointOfInterest)-[:ServesDemographic]->(dr:DemographicRegion) WHERE poi.category = 'Historical Site' AND dr.economic_indicators = 'High Income' RETURN SUM(aa.area_km2) AS total_area

question: Calculate the total population of all AdministrativeAreas that use the 'UTM' coordinate system and have at least one neighboring AdministrativeArea with a different establishment date.
gql: MATCH (aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:LocatedIn]->(l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) WHERE cs.name = 'UTM' RETURN aa1 NEXT MATCH (aa1)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa1.establishment_date <> aa2 RETURN SUM(aa1.population) AS TotalPopulation

question: Identify all InfrastructureNetworks that span across AdministrativeAreas with differing governing bodies and compute the total count of such networks grouped by their network type.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa1:AdministrativeArea) RETURN infra, aa1 NEXT MATCH (infra)-[:Spans]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa1.governing_body <> aa2 RETURN infra.network_type AS NetworkType, COUNT(infra) AS NetworkCount

question: Calculate the average population of AdministrativeAreas that overlap with at least one GeographicZone categorized as 'Urban Planning Area'.
gql: MATCH (gz:GeographicZone {zone_type: 'Urban Planning Area'})-[:OverlapsWith]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN AVG(aa.population) AS AveragePopulation

question: Retrieve the names of all CoordinateSystems that are used by Locations within at least five different AdministrativeAreas, and include the count of distinct AdministrativeAreas for each system.
gql: MATCH (cs:CoordinateSystem)<-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]-(loc:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) RETURN cs, COUNT(aa) AS admin_area_count NEXT RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, admin_area_count AS AdminAreaCount

question: For each CoordinateSystem used by more than five Locations, determine the maximum and minimum elevation among those Locations, and return the CoordinateSystem name along with these elevation values.
gql: MATCH (loc:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem) RETURN cs, COUNT(loc) AS location_count, MAX(loc.elevation) AS max_elevation, MIN(loc.elevation) AS min_elevation NEXT RETURN cs.name AS CoordinateSystemName, max_elevation, min_elevation

question: List all pairs of AdministrativeAreas that share a border and have at least one PointOfInterest of category 'Hospital' in each, returning the names of both AdministrativeAreas and the hospitals located in them.
gql: MATCH (aa1:AdministrativeArea)-[:Borders]->(aa2:AdministrativeArea), (hospital1:PointOfInterest {category: 'Hospital'})<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa1), (hospital2:PointOfInterest {category: 'Hospital'})<-[:ContainsPoi]-(aa2) RETURN aa1.name AS Area1, hospital1.name AS HospitalInArea1, aa2.name AS Area2, hospital2.name AS HospitalInArea2

question: Find the maximum and minimum latitude values among Location nodes that are part of GeographicZones described as 'Mountainous' and use the 'UTM' coordinate system.
gql: MATCH (l:Location)-[:UsesCoordinateSystem]->(cs:CoordinateSystem {name: 'UTM'}), (l)-[:LocatedIn]->(gz:GeographicZone {description: 'Mountainous'}) RETURN MAX(l.latitude) AS max_latitude, MIN(l.latitude) AS min_latitude

question: Find the total capacity of InfrastructureNetworks that span across AdministrativeAreas having a population less than 500,000. Only include networks of type 'Highway'.
gql: MATCH (infra:InfrastructureNetwork)-[:Spans]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE infra.network_type = 'Highway' AND aa.population < 500000 RETURN SUM(infra.capacity) AS TotalCapacity

question: Determine the maximum and minimum area_km2 values among AdministrativeAreas that share a border with another AdministrativeArea using a different coordinate system. Return these values as MaxArea and MinArea respectively.
